front: How do Ridge and Lasso differ in regularization penalty and feature selection?
back: Ridge uses L2 (λΣβⱼ²): it shrinks coefficients toward zero without encouraging exact zeros. Lasso uses L1 (λΣ|βⱼ|): it can set coefficients exactly to zero, selecting features.
context: Memory cue: Ridge reduces; Lasso ropes features out. The intercept is usually not penalized.
